newsitem.title: USA: Boston Edison Pilgrim nuke in restart mode.
newsitem.headline: Boston Edison Pilgrim nuke in restart mode.

text.p: Boston Edison Co's 670 megawatt Pilgrim 1 nuclear power plant in Plymouth, Mass. began startup over the weekend and was expected to synchronize to the electricity grid on Monday, a company spokeswoman said.
The unit was taken off line Sept 17 after a leak was detected at a set of heat exchangers in the reactor building.
"We are in startup and operating at about six percent of capacity, hopefully we will synchronize to the grid sometime today," spokeswoman Carol Wightman said Monday.
The Pilgrim plant accounts for a third of Boston Edison's generating capacity.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
